BiblicalUsage: The word is to sew. Adam and Eve sewed fig leaves together and made themselves aprons, and the Preacher says there is a time to rend and a time to sew. Ezekiel speaks against the women who sew pillows to armholes to hunt souls.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sewing fig leaves was the first human cover-up, and no stitching of our own hides us from God.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
